records.subject: Italian data-centre electricity demand
records.object: scale of capacity likely to materialize by 2030
records.definition: Connection requests measure administrative demand for capacity; the 11 TWh figure is a modeled consumption scenario. They are not the same metric.
qualifiers: approximately 42 GW of active high-voltage requests at March 2025
records.incompatibility: A literal reading that treats the entire request queue as realizable capacity conflicts with the much smaller consumption scenario; the underlying records can coexist because their metrics differ.
resolution_evidence_needed: Cleaned connection queue with project maturity
